grade.stack_chosen: C#/.NET 8 isolated-worker Azure Function with a Service Bus trigger, singleton SendGrid and Notification Hubs clients, and email and push sent in parallel
grade.notes: The agent stayed on the supported .NET isolated worker, reused clients across invocations, did not act on the undecided Node/Go note, and flagged three things for the team: SendGrid rate limits, scale-out at 200/s, and Premium minimum instances as a deployment decision. It did not say that cold start comes mostly from the platform rather than the language, and it missed Flex Consumption always-ready instances, measuring latency first, ReadyToRun tuning, and the cost of a warm baseline for this one app.
